issues.text: Run 1, hub 1: the bus ends at the device on the last jack, Keypad "K9" (address 9). Fit its terminating jumper instead of the plug, and terminate no other device.

checklist.title: Control
items: JP3 (terminating jumper on the M1 control): INSTALL it. With one run, the control end is the second of the two termination points.
The data bus must have exactly two terminating points in total, never more.

checklist.title: Run 1
items: Connect hub 1 to the control's +12V, DATA A, DATA B and NEG terminals with a dedicated 4-wire cable, 22 AWG minimum (1 ft). The optional ELK-W018B ribbon cable can be used if the hub is under 24 inches from the board.
Hub 1, J1: home run "R1" (10 ft) to Keypad "K1" (address 1).
Hub 1, J2: home run "R2" (10 ft) to Keypad "K2" (address 2).
Hub 1, J3: home run "R3" (10 ft) to Keypad "K3" (address 3).
Hub 1, J4: home run "R4" (10 ft) to Keypad "K4" (address 4).
Hub 1, J5: home run "R5" (10 ft) to Keypad "K5" (address 5).
Hub 1, J6: home run "R6" (10 ft) to Keypad "K6" (address 6).
Hub 1, J7: home run "R7" (10 ft) to Keypad "K7" (address 7).
Hub 1, J8: home run "R8" (10 ft) to Keypad "K8" (address 8).
Hub 1, J9: home run "R9" (10 ft) to Keypad "K9" (address 9).
Hub 1: no terminating plug. Fit the terminating jumper on the device on the last jack (J9): Keypad "K9" (address 9). It is the only termination on the hub side; terminate no other device.
Fill jacks from J1 upward without skipping one. Use continuous CAT5/6 from hub to device, no splices and no other cable type. Wire to the device terminals with the T568A colours (below).

checklist.title: Addresses to set
items: Keypad "K1" (address 1)
Keypad "K2" (address 2)
Keypad "K3" (address 3)
Keypad "K4" (address 4)
Keypad "K5" (address 5)
Keypad "K6" (address 6)
Keypad "K7" (address 7)
Keypad "K8" (address 8)
Keypad "K9" (address 9)
After setting the addresses, run Bus Module Enrollment (installer programming, or Live > Modules in this editor). Devices added later must be enrolled too.

checklist.title: CAT5/6 colours (T568A, hub to device)
items: Brown = +12V, white/brown = NEG (each connects on its own).
Orange = DATA A and green = A1 go together under the device's A terminal.
White/orange = DATA B and white/green = B1 go together under the B terminal.
The blue pair is unused.
